findings: StartVacuum is five instructions: own timer, flag, pickup age reset, return. No material or alpha call.
CharacterPlayer.Update selects normal alpha1 if HasInvincibility is false; protected path uses .5 and a final2.5-second fade cycle. It calls SetAlpha before the independent HasVacuum timer branch.
Invincibility expiry restores ApplyPlayerTexture; its tail calls SetAlpha(1).
Magnet-only actor transparency is not supported by these audited native paths. Web keeps magnet independent from invincibility.
limits: This binary has not been proved identical to either video build.
Does not identify video active flags, remote configuration, modified clients, or every other caller that can set invincibility.
Does not infer invincibility from star particles or magnet adjacency.
